t: Sandtex Smooth Masonry Paint offers a high quality, extra-durable water-based coating for exterior walls. Ideal for refreshing tired outdoor surfaces on houses and commercial properties, providing lasting weather protection. Formulated with advanced microseal technology, to ensure easy application with a brush, roller, or spray, delivering maximum coverage while remaining waterproof and dirt-resistant. Effectively covers fine cracks, leaving a smooth, professional finish that is touch-dry in just 3-4 hours and recoatable within the same timeframe.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Pebble-Dash, Render & Stone
